cards.name: Erstwhile Trooper
cards.oracleText: Discard a creature card: This creature gets +2/+2 and gains trample until end of turn. Activate only once each turn.

cards.name: Ersta, Friend to All
cards.oracleText:
+1: Create a 1/1 Human Wizard creature token that's all colors.
−3: Choose a card name from among Enlightened Tutor, Mystical Tutor, Booster Tutor, Imperial Recruiter, and Worldly Tutor. Create a copy of the card with the chosen name. You may cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
−8: You get an emblem with "At the beginning of your upkeep, if you control twenty or more Wizards, you win the game."
Ersta, Friend to All can be your commander.
